review.assessment: The change introduces `solution.ts` from scratch but retains the O(N^2) nested-loop structure explicitly described in the task as the problem to solve. While it satisfies basic correctness, it completely ignores the requirement to optimize for roughly linear time. This leaves a significant performance gap that automated structural and acceptance checks failed to catch due to missing benchmark assertions.

findings.actual: Execution takes several hundred milliseconds to seconds due to O(N^2) iterations, risking timeout on larger inputs
